title: Activate a profile-bound text route for the current session
context: M4-006 needs a first replaceable text connection, verified at its final outbound request boundary. Market data selection, saved private content and workspace operations carry separate permissions.
decision: Use the native Ollama non-streaming chat API as the first adapter. The local human reviews a canonical HTTP loopback or HTTPS destination, chosen model, conversation scope and server-operator charge basis before activation. The existing Rust registry owns the one-use proposal and the profile-bound session grant. It constructs the outbound JSON from the question and up to four recent successful pairs within a bounded window. An owned Python connector sends that projection once and returns text and responding model identity.
authority: M4-006, ADR 0007 and ADR 0011 authorize the implementation choice and the ordinary session grant. Development qualifies the bridge with an owned synthetic loopback peer.

alternatives.option: Use a browser provider SDK and supply the full workspace to its chat session.
alternatives.reason: The Rust registry must select the final permitted data, own revocation and separate the model from saved records and operation authority.

alternatives.option: Persist enabled route grants or rely on a provider conversation identifier.
alternatives.reason: Session-local turns meet this delivery need and make restart, change of recipient and separation from future one-request attachments explicit.

consequences: Local and remote servers use the same replaceable, credential-free adapter. The origin excludes user information, paths, queries and fragments. The worker uses direct HTTP or certificate-verified HTTPS, with a fixed path and a deadline. It follows no redirects and retries no outbound request.

The ordinary text route receives no chart fields, saved private records, tools, audio, profile identity or credential reference. A user-managed endpoint may forward traffic or apply its own charges. ScopeHub displays that boundary before activation.
Disconnect, cancellation and a new reviewed proposal revoke the current grant and drop its history. The profile restarts disconnected. SQLite v1 through v10 retain their existing layout.

The offline mock requires explicit local selection. Configured-route failure stays visible as a failure. Synthetic peer observations establish HTTP behavior; hosted capability evaluation and packaged Windows acceptance have separate gates.
revisit_when: A qualified provider needs trusted credential references, a different connection lifecycle, structured tools, voice or an independently approved context category.
